goal: Add a new RPC to report cumulative global network traffic broken down by direction, network, connection type, and message type
Lets node operators with metered or capped bandwidth see where their traffic goes after per-peer stats are lost on disconnect
reviewability: Stale: needs rebase and author has been silent for about 96 days despite repeated pings for a rebase
agreement: Strong support overall with concept ACKs (epiccurious, danielabrozzoni, stickies-v)
Tested ACK from a real external user who tried it on master and in a monitoring dashboard (waketraindev)
Nonblocking objection: opposed RPC-side aggregation as unnecessary complexity, resolved when author removed it (stickies-v)
Minor unaddressed suggestion to use P2PInterface-based test checks instead of hard-coded values, not blocking (danielabrozzoni)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it is a genuinely requested feature with real prior attempts and at least one external user relying on it
Does not touch correctness, compatibility, or security of the existing RPC surface
Overlapping tracepoint-based alternatives already exist for advanced users, limiting the strategic case
